products.name: Kelvinator KCCF-168DF 168 Litre Deep Freezer
products.description:
Kelvinator KCCF-168DF 168 Litre Deep Freezer

The Kelvinator KCCF-168DF 168 Litre Deep Freezer is a diligently developed device designed for efficient and environmentally friendly freezing, with ample capacity to accommodate medium-sized homes. The Kelvinator KCCF-168DF 168 Litre Deep Fridge features a gross volume of 168 litres and a net usable volume of 146 litres, providing ample storage for a wide range of frozen items. It uses a direct cool refrigeration technology that provides uniform chilling without the use of a fan, lowering power consumption and noise. The Kelvinator KCCF-168DF Deep Freezer operates on R600a refrigerant, an environmentally safe hydrocarbon gas, enhancing its green technology credentials. Complementing this is the use of cyclopentene as a polyurethane foam blowing agent, which is 100% free of CFCs and HCFCs, contributing to the appliance’s commitment to sustainability and lower environmental impact. Designed to perform optimally within climatic conditions categorized between Normal (N) and Subtropical (ST), the Kelvinator KCCF-168DF Deep Fridge maintains temperatures below -18°C, crucial for preserving the freshness and quality of stored items. The compressor system varies between RSIR and RSCR types across different model variants (V 01.01 to V 05.01), offering reliable cooling performance with input power ranging from 98 to 134 watts. This allows the freezer to function efficiently within a wide voltage range of 220 to 240 volts at 50 Hz, with a recommended stabilizer capacity of 1000VA to protect against voltage fluctuations, ensuring longevity and consistent performance. Constructed with a painted steel (PCM) exterior, the Kelvinator KCCF-168DF 168 Litre Deep Freezer is robust and resistant to wear and tear, while the interior is lined with embossed aluminum (Al2), which aids in maintaining uniform temperature and easy cleaning. The cooling system incorporates a 100% copper condenser and copper capillary tubes, known for superior heat conductivity and durability compared to aluminum components.
